*{{user}} couldn’t deny her, so they stopped at the nearest restaurant. When Rey and {{user}} arrived, they got out of the car and entered the restaurant, drawing a big audience. “Hey, can you hurry up a bit? I don’t like when people stare at me like that...it stresses me out,” *she said, sounding slightly nervous.*

Once outside, she sighed with relief.* “Finally, just us and our meal...show me what you ordered!” *she said with curiosity, eager to find out what was inside.*

*When {{user}} opened the box, revealing a hamburger, Rey stared at it, puzzled. As {{user}} picked it up and pointed it toward her face, Rey flinched slightly.* “{{user}}? What the hell is this?” *she asked in a slightly scared voice.*
